column1: # Columns: the weapon's editor ID (as in FalloutNV.esm, the DLC, Gun Runners' Arsenal and the
# packs), the multiplier of its calibre's muzzle velocity (1.0 = the calibre's own), and why.
# Long or heavy barrels, rifles of a pistol calibre, unique and stronger variants higher; snub,
# sawed-off and integrally suppressed guns lower. On top of it: the ammo load, barrel and
# suppressor mods, and the game's projectile-speed multiplier.
# Every editor ID is a WEAP record of the official masters (read from FalloutNV.esm, the DLC
# esms, GunRunnersArsenal.esm and the packs, 2026-11-15; the test data/official_weapons.tsv):
# every official calibre gun (an ammo-firing gun whose ammo is a calibre of crate::ballistics),
# NPC and turret variants included, has an entry. A gun without one (a mod's) gets its damage
# against its calibre's average gun (gun_velocity.rs, within 0.9 to 1.1). Not here: the Nail Gun
# (nails) and the Red Glare (rockets), which fire no calibre round.
